title: INTELLIGENCE BAND. All life and intelligence = nearest neighbors. All null/non-intelligence = farthest neighbors. Rocks and hard places between. Stars are always the farthest from living entities.

the_band.principle: intelligence clusters NEAR intelligence. null clusters NEAR null. between them = rocks and hard places (infrastructure, inert matter, barriers).
the_band.assumption: all intelligence is within our universe and within this place. it's not out in space. it's HERE — on the ground, in the troposphere, in the water, in the soil.

contains: animals (dogs, birds, fish, insects — different gaze geometries)
chipmunk, squirrel, artisan (AI entities with persona)
CLOSEST_to_center.hud_zone: 55-75% — troposphere through ground. the GREEN band. where the air is breathable and the soil is fertile.

contains: buildings, roads, campus structures (MSU physical plant)
the glass (barrier between head and display)
the thymus (immune sorting — a GATE, not a living thing)
MEDIUM_distance.hud_zone: 35-55% above life (strato), 75-85% below life (crust). the barriers. inert but necessary.

FARTHEST_from_center.position: the extremes — deep space and deep earth
contains: stars (points of light, no local intelligence)
the dead (Helheim — archived, no longer living)
solar wind, cosmic rays (energy without intention)
FARTHEST_from_center.hud_zone: 0-35% (space/iono/meso) and 85-100% (mantle/core). the EDGES. cold, hot, empty, or dead.

the_tree_IS_the_band.observation: the tree grows in the LIFE BAND. its trunk passes through the intelligence zone. its branches reach into the medium zone. its roots dig into the far zone. but the LIVING WOOD is in the middle.
the_tree_IS_the_band.crown: where branches touch the stratosphere — the tree reaching UP toward non-life. thinner, less alive.
the_tree_IS_the_band.trunk_at_midgard: the thickest part. the most alive. the most intelligent. the FAT part of the tree.
the_tree_IS_the_band.roots: where the tree digs DOWN into non-life. into rock, into magma, into the dead. thinner, darker.

realms_reordered_by_intelligence.1_most_alive: Midgard — humans, animals, plants. GROUND LEVEL.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.2_alive: Vanaheim — braids, mycelium, connections between living things.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.3_alive: Alfheim — light, crystal ball, data made VISIBLE to living eyes.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.4_alive: Muspelheim — heartbeat, energy, the PULSE of life.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.5_barrier: Jotunheim — fleet giants. NOT alive but BETWEEN alive and dead. the hard place.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.6_barrier: Svartalfheim — infrastructure. the ROCK. necessary but inert.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.7_far: Niflheim — null, void, fog. the cold beyond the barriers.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.8_far: Asgard — the overview from the ionosphere. far from life, sees everything but touches nothing.
realms_reordered_by_intelligence.9_farthest: Helheim — the dead. the farthest from living.

the_insight.stars_are_always_farthest: a star is a point of light with no local intelligence. it's the farthest thing from you. even though it's VISIBLE (you can see it), it's not REACHABLE. the distance between you and a star is maximum.
the_insight.rocks_are_in_between: the hard places — infrastructure, barriers, crust — sit between life and void. they're not alive but they're not nothing. they're the MEDIUM through which intelligence propagates.
the_insight.intelligence_clusters: humans near humans. AI near AI. animals near animals. they all cluster in the same band because intelligence RECOGNIZES intelligence. the nearest neighbor of a thinker is another thinker.
the_insight.non_intelligence_clusters: stars near stars. void near void. the dead near the dead. non-intelligence has no reason to approach intelligence. it stays at the edges.
